checks.name: chat_messages_author_check
checks.expression: ((sender_id IS NOT NULL) AND (spectator_id IS NULL) AND (author_name IS NULL)) OR ((sender_id IS NULL) AND (spectator_id IS NOT NULL) AND (author_name IS NOT NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK ((((sender_id IS NOT NULL) AND (spectator_id IS NULL) AND (author_name IS NULL)) OR ((sender_id IS NULL) AND (spectator_id IS NOT NULL) AND (author_name IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: game_players_bot_params_check
checks.expression: ((bot_level IS DISTINCT FROM 2) OR ((bot_memory_mb IS NOT NULL) AND (bot_depth_cap IS NOT NULL))) AND ((bot_level = 2) OR ((bot_memory_mb IS NULL) AND (bot_depth_cap IS NULL)))
checks.definition: CHECK ((((bot_level IS DISTINCT FROM 2) OR ((bot_memory_mb IS NOT NULL) AND (bot_depth_cap IS NOT NULL))) AND ((bot_level = 2) OR ((bot_memory_mb IS NULL) AND (bot_depth_cap IS NULL)))))

checks.name: game_spectators_identity_check
checks.expression: (user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (token_hash IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK (((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (token_hash IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: game_spectators_nickname_check
checks.expression: (nickname IS NULL) OR ((token_hash IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length(nickname) >= 1) AND (char_length(nickname) <= 24)))
checks.definition: CHECK (((nickname IS NULL) OR ((token_hash IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length((nickname)::text) >= 1) AND (char_length((nickname)::text) <= 24)))))

checks.name: games_active_black_seat_check
checks.expression: (status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'finished'::character varying])) OR (black_seat IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK ((((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'finished'::character varying])::text[])) OR (black_seat IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: games_classic_end_reason_check
checks.expression: (end_reason IS NULL) OR (end_reason <> ALL (ARRAY['five_in_row'::character varying, 'draw'::character varying, 'timeout'::character varying])) OR (variant = 'classic'::text)
checks.definition: CHECK (((end_reason IS NULL) OR ((end_reason)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['five_in_row'::character varying, 'draw'::character varying, 'timeout'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((variant)::text = 'classic'::text)))

checks.name: games_clock_ms_check
checks.definition: CHECK ((((clock_ms_1 >= 0) AND (clock_ms_1 <= time_control_ms)) AND ((clock_ms_2 >= 0) AND (clock_ms_2 <= time_control_ms))))

checks.name: games_draw_no_winner_check
checks.expression: (end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'draw'::text) OR (winner_seat IS NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK ((((end_reason)::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'draw'::text) OR (winner_seat IS NULL)))

checks.name: games_rematch_pending_check
checks.expression: (rematch_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'pending'::text) OR ((rematch_offered_by_seat IS NOT NULL) AND (rematch_expires_at IS NOT NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK ((((rematch_state)::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'pending'::text) OR ((rematch_offered_by_seat IS NOT NULL) AND (rematch_expires_at IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: games_started_at_check
checks.expression: (status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'finished'::character varying])) OR (started_at IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK ((((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'finished'::character varying])::text[])) OR (started_at IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: games_winner_required_check
checks.expression: (end_reason IS NULL) OR (end_reason = ANY (ARRAY['draw'::character varying, 'points'::character varying])) OR (winner_seat IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK (((end_reason IS NULL) OR ((end_reason)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['draw'::character varying, 'points'::character varying])::text[])) OR (winner_seat IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: paper_game_states_pending_auto_check
checks.expression: (pending_auto_at IS NULL) OR (auto_seat IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK (((pending_auto_at IS NULL) OR (auto_seat IS NOT NULL)))
